title: Common providers: Netherlands
coverage: Complete for the national fixed-line carriers, cable and the mobile network operators, and the main wholesale fibre networks; business ISPs are partial.
missing: AS numbers for the wholesale-only fibre networks (they sell no internet service)
An announced AS number for Trined (AS204893 is registered to it and was not announced on the read date)

sources.name: ACM (Authority for Consumers and Markets): telecom market publications
sources.terms: The site's terms allow linking; no reuse licence was found on the read date, so nothing is copied.
sources.result: The page answered on the read date. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in the Netherlands
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 5 of 18 candidate names were found on the page (the 17 entries of version 1.0.0; later entries were not looked up there).

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 18 of 19 websites and 3 support or status pages answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 19 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company or an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.terms: CC0 1.0: no conditions. The item id of a provider is recorded as a stable cross-reference.
sources.result: 4 entries carry the id of their own Wikidata item; each item states one of the entry's AS numbers (property P3797). A parent group's item is not used.

sources.name: PeeringDB
sources.terms: The acceptable use policy forbids reproducing PeeringDB data outside approved operational purposes: nothing is copied; cited as a place to look up an AS number.

providers.name: KPN
providers.notes: XS4ALL is a KPN name since 2022 (AS3265 is registered to KPN and was not announced on the read date).

providers.name: Odido
providers.notes: Formerly T-Mobile Netherlands and Tele2; fixed and mobile.

providers.name: Ziggo
providers.notes: Cable; part of VodafoneZiggo. AS9143 is registered to Vodafone Libertel and was not announced on the read date.

providers.name: Vodafone
providers.notes: Mobile; part of VodafoneZiggo. The fixed network (AS33915, AS9143) is on Ziggo. AS15480 was not announced on the read date.

providers.name: Glaspoort
providers.notes: Wholesale fibre access network (KPN and APG); never the name on the bill.

providers.name: Open Dutch Fiber
providers.notes: Wholesale fibre access network; retail through Odido and others.

providers.name: Trined
providers.notes: AS204893 is registered to it and was not announced on the read date, so it is not listed as its number.

providers.name: SURF
providers.notes: The national research and education network.
